subject: Request for extended trial + extra credits (follow-up)
messages:
From: Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@velvetai.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: 2-week trial extension + additional eval credits

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the quick onboarding call earlier this week — the team at Velvet AI got good signal from a few runs but we hit a limit on tokens during a long training sweep. We still need another couple of large-batch evaluations to validate our latency optimizations before we commit to a Dedicated seat.

Would Redwood be able to provide a 2-week extension on our trial and an extra 200k token credit? We’ve already used the initial allotment and requested a top-up last month; I know your policy about repeat top-ups but we’re a small research org and this will determine our procurement decision.

If helpful, I can share the run configs and a brief timeline for the remaining tests.

Best,
Alyssa Turner
Head of Infrastructure, Velvet AI
ops@velvetai.com

Attachments: none
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@velvetai.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-25T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: 2-week trial extension + additional eval credits

Hi Alyssa — thanks for the context and glad the initial runs were useful. I copied Sean from Sales and Ben from Risk/Revenue so we can triage the request quickly.

Before we approve another top-up I need two things:
- A short description of the remaining experiments (what model variant, dataset size, and whether you’ll be running parallel accounts).
- Confirmation of the org identity (we show several recent sign-ups that look related to your domain; please confirm these are internal).

Sean / Ben — can you pull usage telemetry for Velvet AI and any related accounts (IP overlap, concurrent sessions, recent top-ups)? If there’s anything that looks like coordinated multi-account testing, I want to flag this for a brief fraud review.

I’ll hold on the extension until we get those details.

Thanks,
Soojin
Sr. Account Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-26T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: 2-week trial extension + additional eval credits (fraud triage)

Adding the quick triage results here. Summary: usage patterns show three separate trial accounts (velvetai-team1@, velvetai-team2@, velvetai-research@) requesting top-ups within a 48-hour window over the last 5 weeks. Token consumption spikes line up with the same set of external IPs (two /24 ranges) and identical user-agent strings in the requests.

I’m attaching a CSV with per-account daily token use and a screenshot highlighting overlapping sessions. Also attached are the last two invoice PDFs for their paid test top-ups.

Prelim opinion: high risk for multi-account trial extension attempts (likely organizational reuse or potential attempt to bypass per-org limits). Recommend hold on additional credits pending confirmation of org structure and an exec-level attestation from VelvetAI.

If Sales wants a partial goodwill grant we could offer a one-time 50k token credit while we await verification, rather than full 200k. Let me know.

—Sean
Head of Growth, Redwood Inference

Attachments: usage_report.csv, screenshot_concurrent_accounts.png, recent_invoices.pdf
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-27T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: 2-week trial extension + additional eval credits (fraud triage)

Thanks both — I reviewed Sean's attachments and the overlap is clear. Policy position: we do not approve repeated organization-level trial top-ups that bypass our per-org evaluation limits without a verified enterprise contract.

Action items:
- Do not issue the 200k token extension.
- Offer a one-time 50k token goodwill credit (no further top-ups) conditioned on VelvetAI providing a short attestation (company letter confirming single legal entity, list of team emails) and a designated POC for billing.
- Block additional trial top-up attempts on the three accounts until we receive the attestation.
- Sales (Soojin): please send a concise note to Alyssa with the outcome and next steps. Finance/Risk (Ben): please enact the temporary hold and flag for monitoring.

Soojin — draft the customer-facing message and include the required attestation fields; keep the tone helpful but firm.

Neha Kapoor
VP, Trust & Compliance
Redwood Inference
